تعتكدي (form VIII)
# تَعْتَكِدِي (taʕtakidī) /taʕ.ta.ki.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# تُعْتَكَدِي (tuʕtakadī) /tuʕ.ta.ka.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
